Subject: LatticeOps inference pilot — demo confirmation

Hi Samir,

Quick note to confirm our demo on Tuesday, Nov 17 at 10:00 AM PT. We'll walk through the inference flow, latency/cost tradeoffs for your use case, and a short sandbox setup. Attached a short overview deck and a first-pass SOW in case procurement wants an early look.

Subject: Re: LatticeOps inference pilot — demo confirmation

Hi Irene,

Really appreciate the materials and the setup — looks great. Unfortunately, we had a last-minute shift on our roadmap: our product org just prioritized a cross-team cloud migration (GCP regional expansion + data platform consolidation) and a security initiative that pulls the infra folks you would meet. That means the inference pilot for Q4 needs to move to backlog.

Can we do the following?
- Pause the live demo for now — we'll re-open in Q1 2027.
- Keep the materials available to internal stakeholders (procurement will still review the SOW).
- Can you share the security questionnaire answers so our compliance team can keep evaluating in parallel?

I know this is not ideal — we still want to run a pilot, just later in the year once the migration and hiring lanes settle down.

Apologies for the churn.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Engineering Operations
LatticeOps
samir@latticeops.com

Team — forwarding Samir's note. TL;DR: LatticeOps pushed the pilot to backlog because of a platform migration + security push. A few proposed follow-ups below.

Proposed next steps:
1) Put LO-4921 on the "hold: roadmap" stage in HubSpot and set a reminder for first-week Jan 2027. (Karthik, can you handle?)
2) Share the filled security questionnaire (attached) directly with Samir's compliance folks so they can keep evaluating during the migration window.
3) Offer limited sandbox access (token-limited, low-cost) so Eng teams can experiment asynchronously — makes it easier to reaccelerate once they unfreeze. Optionally include 90-day credit if they commit to a Q1 pilot.
4) Mark this as a potential discount ask; if procurement pushes, we can escalate a one-time credit up to $5k (Marissa to own approvals).
5) Schedule a 20-min check-in for Jan 10–14 to reassess timeline.

Attachments: security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx

Notes: Samir specifically called out headcount and infra being reallocated. This feels like a high-quality future opportunity — keeping them warm is low lift. Thoughts?

— Irene
